title: Simple Counter
description: A simple numerical counter that shows in chat with keybinds.
body:
# Simple Counter for Fabric 1.21.x
A simple and easy to use counter for Minecraft! Numbers go up and down by 1, with deafult keybinds being `PageUp` to add, and `PageDown` to subtract. View counter by `/cs` or `/counter show`

**SimpleCounter By `ilovelifethankyou` on Discord**
#### Requires [Fabric API](https://modrinth.com/project/P7dR8mSH)
![Example Messages](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/b15b422255a930b81af3e90531203c456d5eda4c.png)



# Commands
- `/counter show` - Shows counter
- `/counter reset` - Resets counter
- `/cs` - Show counter shortcut
# Customizable Keybinds
- `Add` - Adds number - Default `PGUP`
- `Subtract` - Removes number - Default `PGDN`



# Coming Soon:
### Counter preset - 
Starting the counter at a number, negative numbers too
- `/counter set <#>` - Preset counter
### Multiple counters/counter loading - 
For saving counters between game sessions
- `/counter create <name>`
- `/counter save <name>` - for saving an unnamed list 
- `/counter load <counter>`
- `/counter list` - Lists counter names and numbers
- Message should show (+/-) <name> Counter: <#>
### Help command - 
For help with all these commands
- `/counter help` - Help command
